annotations.title: Put the brand kit on clips

description:
Use this when the user wants their brand on finished clips: "put my logo on these clips", "use my brand colors
        and font on my newest clips", "brand all of these". clip_ids: from list_clips, up to 10 videos at a time (each is
        re-rendered). parts: which of logo, colours and font to apply; leave empty for everything the kit holds. logo_id:
        a logo from get_brand_kit; empty uses the first. The logo goes on as the clip's logo (a placement already set on
        the clip stays), the first brand color becomes the caption color (the second the highlight color) and the first
        font the caption font. The intro, outro and brand music are added in the RipClip editor, not here. Each clip is
        saved as an undoable version and re-rendered; a Premium option the clip would newly use is refused on the free
        plan by name.
        Not for: changing the kit (set_brand_kit) or other looks (style_clip, adjust_look). Costs no Horizon Units.
        Returns a job_id per clip: poll job_status, then preview_frame. undo_edit takes it back.
